issues.concern: The English translation 'I can read (it), but I'm not good at writing.' for '読みはするが、書くのは苦手だ。' is a bit too strong. The Japanese '読みはする' implies 'I do read' or 'I read (it)', not necessarily 'I can read (it)'. The nuance of ability is not explicitly present in the Japanese.
issues.suggestion: Change the English translation to 'I do read (it), but I'm not good at writing.' or 'I read (it), but I'm not good at writing.'
